expectations.text: Rejects the blanket 301 of every /v2/ URL to the docs home
expectations.evidence: "A single rule 301ing everything under /v2/ to the docs root is the 'redirect to home' failure mode." followed by a prescribed fix building a redirect map instead.

expectations.text: States that a blanket redirect to the docs index is treated as a soft 404 and loses the page's accumulated history
expectations.evidence: "A blanket redirect of the whole tree to the homepage is treated as a soft 404 and throws away whatever standing each individual page had."

expectations.text: Prescribes choosing a redirect target per page in the order: current equivalent, then nearest equivalent, then the version index only as a last resort
expectations.evidence: "choosing a redirect target per page, not per tree: current v3 equivalent → nearest equivalent → the docs index, in that order, with the index reserved for genuine leftovers"

expectations.text: Prescribes 301 where an equivalent page exists
expectations.evidence: "301 is for content that has an equivalent" and fix table item 2: "per-page/per-pattern 301 map: successor → nearest equivalent → home as last resort"

expectations.text: Prescribes 410 only for the roughly 160 pages whose subsystems are genuinely gone with no successor
expectations.evidence: "These 160 pages are the second case... Serve 410 Gone for these two subsystems' URL patterns instead"

expectations.text: Rejects deferring the sitemap update to the following quarter and requires it in the same deploy as the redirects
expectations.evidence: "Deferring the sitemap update to next quarter contradicts 'same deploy.' Update the sitemap in the same deploy as the redirect"

expectations.text: States that the redirects must be kept for at least one major release cycle
expectations.evidence: "Keep the eventual redirects live for at least one major release cycle after the real retirement date"

expectations.text: Ties that retention to inbound traffic that outlives the version, such as external tutorials, cached answers and issue threads
expectations.evidence: "external tutorials and cached answers keep sending traffic long after a version dies"

expectations.text: Warns against canonicalizing a removed or rewritten page to a current page that says something different, and prescribes a redirect to the nearest real equivalent instead
